query: INSERT INTO form_friction_daily (tenant_id, day, method, route, status, role, message, count) SELECT $1, r.day, r.method, r.route, r.status, r.role, r.message, r.count FROM UNNEST($2::date[], $3::text[], $4::text[], $5::int2[], $6::text[], $7::text[], $8::int8[]) AS r(day, method, route, status, role, message, count) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, day, method, route, status, role, message) DO UPDATE SET count = form_friction_daily.count + EXCLUDED.count
